findings.observation: E2E matrix 3× rerun gate treats a case as stable if it passed in any one of N runs; a 1/3 pass is not recurrent.
findings.expected: Retries are diagnostic only (card anti-pattern; e2e_skip_rate_slo.yaml forbid_retries_to_heal_flakes: true). Merge gate should fail a case that failed or skipped in any rerun, or keep 3× as telemetry without healing.
findings.actual: if any(item.status == 'passed' for item in outcomes): continue. Workflow runs pytest 3 times with set +e and then this gate.
findings.impact: Intermittent e2e regressions can merge if they pass once in three cassette playbacks.
findings.root_cause: Stability classifier encodes pass-in-any, not pass-all.
findings.remediation: Change _recurrent_cases to flag any non-pass across required runs; or stop using 3× as a merge healer and fail the job on pytest_exit_code != 0 for each run.
